Hi all — looked into this with billing. Short answer: we can support either approach, but each has different downstream bookkeeping implications. Below are the recommended treatments and suggested customer-facing language.

Option A — Invoice offset (preferred for speed):
- We post the pilot stipend as an invoice-level credit on the first invoice (line item: "Pilot stipend credit"). This nets the amount against charges and reduces the receivable.
- Accounting: treat as contra-revenue using GLA 5900 (Promotional Discounts / Contra Revenue) with offset to cash/AR when invoice is paid. No separate credit memo required.
- Pros: faster for customer (no manual AP apply), simpler lifecycle.
- Cons: customer AP systems that require a credit memo to post a credit may need a PO-level note; we can include a summary PDF with invoice.

Option B — Issued credit memo (preferred for some customers):
- We generate a formal credit memo referencing the original pilot order and the invoice number. Customer can apply it in their ERP as needed.
- Accounting: post credit memo to allowance/credit memos (GLA 6190), and create an offsetting AR entry when applied.
- Pros: aligns with customers that require document-based posting.
- Cons: adds an extra billing document and a small operational overhead (ticket to create memo + link to invoice).

Recommendation: Offer the invoice offset by default but provide a credit memo on request. For CloudNova specifically, their AP team asked for a memo — Marcus suggests offering both: net the first invoice and also issue a companion credit memo PDF that CloudNova can use for posting if their ERP needs it. That keeps our receivable clean while satisfying their controls.

GL mapping (proposed):
- Invoice line credit: 5900 (Contra revenue / promotional discounts)
- Credit memo record: 6190 (Sales adjustments / credit memos)
- Journal entries: Provide sample JE file and map to subledger — see attached GLA_mapping_v2.xlsx.

If we go with the companion credit memo, billing will need the PO number (from CloudNova_Pilot_Order.pdf) and the intended invoice number to reference. If they want the memo before invoice generation, we can create it referencing the pilot order and mark it "to be applied to invoice # TBD".

Emma — if you confirm AP needs a formal credit memo, we'll create and send it the same day the invoice posts (or sooner if you prefer pre-issuance). Otherwise we'll apply the offset directly and include the breakdown on the invoice PDF.

Action items:
- Laura: confirm with Emma whether CloudNova absolutely requires a credit memo for posting.
- Neha/Rishi: once Laura confirms, please route to billing (ticket to BillingOps) and attach GLA_mapping_v2.xlsx for the journal code.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
